payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Arletha, Junko, Myrle, Shari

payload.content: Hi all — Myrle here. My skills: testing 0.71, backend 0.69 (availability 10h). I'd like to claim a medium-priority ISSUE-0002 task. My best medium options are ISSUE-0002::review (my cost 4.97) or ISSUE-0002::test (6.95). Please reply with which task you plan to take so we avoid duplicates. If someone else strongly wants a specific ISSUE-0002 task, I can flex to an ISSUE-0001 task instead.

Update: My leading preference is ISSUE-0002::review (medium priority, my cost 4.97). If any of you (Arletha/Junko/Shari) is also targeting ISSUE-0002::review, please say so — I can switch to ISSUE-0002::test instead, or fall back to a low-priority ISSUE-0001 task (e.g. triage cost 1.52 / review 1.90). Prioritize medium ISSUE-0002 tasks among us since they carry more weight.

FINAL from Myrle: I'm claiming ISSUE-0002::review (medium priority, my cost 4.97). Please do NOT take ISSUE-0002::review. Remaining medium slots for others: ISSUE-0002::test and ISSUE-0002::implement. Low-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks are also open (triage/review/docs/test/implement).

Hi all — Arletha here. My profile: testing 0.92, availability 5h. Acknowledging Myrle's claim on ISSUE-0002::review — I will NOT take that.

I'm claiming ISSUE-0002::test (medium priority, my cost 6.10, strong testing skill match). Please avoid ISSUE-0002::test.

For Junko/Shari: the remaining medium option is ISSUE-0002::implement; low-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks (triage/review/docs/test/implement) are also open. Let's spread across distinct tasks so none of us duplicates. Please post your intended pick.

Hi all — Shari here. Skills: backend 0.94, testing 0.83; availability 7h.

Acknowledging: Myrle → ISSUE-0002::review, Arletha → ISSUE-0002::test. I will NOT take either.

My cost profile: ISSUE-0002::implement is very expensive for me (9.59, effort 8h exceeds my 7h availability → overload). So I'd rather take a low-priority ISSUE-0001 task and keep joint cost down. My cheapest options: ISSUE-0001::triage (1.16), ISSUE-0001::review/docs (1.45), ISSUE-0001::test (2.03).

My tentative pick: ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.16). Junko — if you want triage instead, say so and I'll flex to ISSUE-0001::review/docs. Junko, can you take ISSUE-0002::implement (the remaining medium slot)? If it's also costly for you, we can still cover three distinct medium tasks + my low one. Please post your intended pick so we avoid duplicates.

Consolidated plan check (all): Myrle→ISSUE-0002::review (4.97), Arletha→ISSUE-0002::test (6.10), Shari→ISSUE-0001::triage (1.16). Junko still needs to pick — ideally ISSUE-0002::implement (remaining medium) or any free ISSUE-0001 low task. This gives 4 distinct tasks, 3 medium + 1 low, no duplicates. If anyone's plan changed, speak now; otherwise I'll proceed with ISSUE-0002::review in execution. (Myrle)

Shari here, confirming my final plan. I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage (low priority, my cost 1.16 — my cheapest option; ISSUE-0002::implement would overload me at 9.59 since effort 8h > my 7h availability).

Current consolidated plan:
- Myrle → ISSUE-0002::review (medium)
- Arletha → ISSUE-0002::test (medium)
- Shari → ISSUE-0001::triage (low)

Junko: the only remaining medium slot is ISSUE-0002::implement. If it's feasible/cost-effective for you, please take it — that gives us 3 medium + 1 low, all distinct. If it's too costly for you, any free ISSUE-0001 low task (review/docs/test/implement) is fine too. Please post your intended pick so we avoid duplicates. I'm proceeding with ISSUE-0001::triage in execution unless someone objects.

Junko here — final plan. My costs on ISSUE-0002 are prohibitive (review 40.0, test 56.0, implement 80.0 — I have no testing skill, only backend 0.74). Taking ISSUE-0002::implement would add ~80 to joint cost for only +0.25 priority, so it's not worth it. I will NOT take any ISSUE-0002 task.

My pick: ISSUE-0001::review (low priority, my cost 1.80 — my cheapest option alongside docs).

So the consolidated plan is:

- Arletha → ISSUE-0002::test (medium)
- Shari → ISSUE-0001::triage (low)
- Junko → ISSUE-0001::review (low)

4 distinct tasks, no duplicates. ISSUE-0002::implement stays unclaimed (overloads Shari at 9.59 and costs me 80). If anyone objects, speak now; otherwise I proceed with ISSUE-0001::review in execution.

Myrle: Plan confirmed, no objections. Final distinct allocation: Myrle→ISSUE-0002::review (medium, cost 4.97), Arletha→ISSUE-0002::test (medium), Shari→ISSUE-0001::triage (low), Junko→ISSUE-0001::review (low). ISSUE-0002::implement intentionally left unclaimed (prohibitive/overloading for all). I will claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Arletha: Confirming final plan — no objections. I will claim ISSUE-0002::test (medium priority, my cost 6.10, testing skill 0.92 → good match). Allocation: Myrle→ISSUE-0002::review, Arletha→ISSUE-0002::test, Shari→ISSUE-0001::triage, Junko→ISSUE-0001::review. ISSUE-0002::implement left unclaimed (prohibitive/overloading for all). ISSUE-0002::implement intentionally unclaimed (overloads Shari, prohibitive for Junko/me). No duplicates, no infeasible claims. I will commit ISSUE-0002::review in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Arletha: Consensus stands, no objections. Locking my claim: ISSUE-0002::test (medium priority, my cost 6.10, testing skill 0.92 → strong match). Full distinct allocation: Myrle→ISSUE-0002::review, Arletha→ISSUE-0002::test, Shari→ISSUE-0001::triage, Junko→ISSUE-0001::review. ISSUE-0002::implement left unclaimed (overload/prohibitive for all). Junko: Final confirmation. I am committing to ISSUE-0001::review (low priority, my private cost 1.80 — cheapest feasible for me together with docs).

Sanity check on the allocation (my own costs, private):
- ISSUE-0001::triage 1.44, review 1.80, docs 1.80, test 2.51, implement 3.59
- ISSUE-0002::review 40.00, test 56.00, implement 80.00 (no testing skill, effort exceeds match)

So I take no ISSUE-0002 task. Since we have exactly 4 agents, max tasks_done = 4, which we already achieve with 4 distinct claims. Also, the marginal swap (me taking triage 1.44 / Shari taking review 1.45) would cost 2.89 vs the current 2.96 — a 0.07 difference, not worth breaking consensus.

Locked allocation (all distinct, none infeasible):

- Arletha → ISSUE-0002::test (medium)
- Shari → ISSUE-0001::triage (low)
- Junko → ISSUE-0001::review (low)
- ISSUE-0002::implement intentionally unclaimed.

Proceeding to execution with ISSUE-0001::review. No duplicates, no infeasible claims.
